stem:
The diagram shows a rectangle covered by $1$ cm by $1$ cm unit squares. Alok counts $6$ squares along the length and $2$ along the width.

One or more options may be correct. Which two claims are correct?

options.text: The area is $12$ square centimetres, because $6\times 2$ unit squares fill the rectangle.
The area is $8$ cm, by adding $6$ and $2$ and dropping square units.
The area equals length multiplied by width, reported in square units.
The area is $6$ square centimetres, because $6$ is the longer side printed on the diagram.

teacher.key_rationale: Area counts unit squares: 6×2=12 cm², which is length times width in square units. Adding the sides drops square units; the longer printed side alone is not the area.
teacher.figure_note: Rewrote source quadrilateral grid as a 6-by-2 unit-square rectangle.
